race.description: Western Farm Machinery B&C Coxsedge Memorial Hcp (Bm50)
race.comment: BLUE BIDDY (6) stuck on gamely into fourth last start at Warren. That followed a win on debut at Narromine. Faces an easier assignment so she can return to the winners' list. ANGIE'S SISTER (2) was in the market second-up on the back of a bold first-up outing but ran below expectations, finishing fifth. Strips fitter third-up and can give a bold sight from the favourable draw. BEAUNIFIED (3) struggled under the big weight last time so will enjoy getting some relief on the quick back-up. The booking of JPH is a good sign. EMPHATIC BEL (4) is yet to threaten in her two runs back but drops in grade so will find this easier. Not without her chance.
